description: Build a vision board collage from your uploaded images and affirmations, then download it as PNG.

faqs.a: Click Upload Images and choose photos from your device, or type affirmations. Then click Build Board to lay them out on a canvas.
faqs.q: How do I make a vision board?

faqs.a: The layout is automatic: images and affirmations are tiled in a grid on a 1200×900 canvas. Refresh to shuffle the order.
faqs.q: How is the board laid out?

faqs.a: Click Download PNG to save a 1200×900 image of your board.
No — uploads stay in your browser memory only for the session. Download the PNG if you want to keep the board.

howto: Click Build Board to generate the collage.
Click Download PNG to save it.
title: Vision Board Maker
